Sub: - Deep Depression over Southwest & adjoining Southeast Bay of Bengal [Cyclone Alert
for Andhra-Pradesh and adjoining areas of North Tamil Nadu coasts]
The Deep Depression over Southeast & adjoining Southwest Bay of Bengal moved west-northwestwards
with speed of 20 kmph during past 3 hours, and lay centered at 0830 hours IST of today, the 01st
November, 2026 over Southwest & adjoining Southeast Bay of Bengal, near Latitude 11.8°N and
Longitude 85.9°E, about 630 km east-southeast of Chennai (Tamil Nadu), 710 km south-southeast of
Vishakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh), 710 km east-southeast of Nellore (Andhra Pradesh), 710 km
southeast of Machilipatnam (Andhra Pradesh) and 750 km east-southeast of Ongole (Andhra Pradesh).
It is very likely to move west-northwestwards and intensify into a Cyclonic Storm over Southwest &
adjoining Westcentral Bay of Bengal during next 6 hours and into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over
Westcentral Bay of Bengal on 2nd November. Continuing to move west-northwestwards, it is very likely
to cross south Andhra Pradesh coast as a Severe Cyclonic Storm with wind speed of 100 to 110 kmph
gusting 120kmph between Nellore and Narsapur by morning of 3rd November 2026.
